facts.text: Alan, eat something first. Then we try the raptor resonator, I promise it's on our side.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Billy's words, but he never says it. His real lines on the quote page include 'They set a trap. They actually set a trap.' A real Grant line fits the island better: 'No force on earth or heaven could get me on that island.'
facts.fix: "No force on earth or heaven could get me on that island." (Alan Grant)

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the satellite phone rings inside the spinosaurus.
facts.why: The Spinosaurus swallows Paul's satellite phone, and later it rings inside the dinosaur. Fits.

facts.text: Billy's satchel held raptor eggs. This holds corn.
facts.why: Billy stole the raptor eggs, which caused the raptor attacks. Fits.

vibe.verdict: A good camp setting with the phone, the raptor eggs and the pteranodons all in, and a clever tagline.
